message.reasoning:
The user wants two things:

1) "尋找洛杉磯所有的超市" – find all supermarkets in Los Angeles.

2) "並找出邁阿密最受歡迎的旅遊景點。" – find the most popular sightseeing spot in Miami (most likely with default kids-friendly? They didn't specify but we can use default).

We have two tool calls available: supermarket_find_in_city and sightseeing_popular_in_city.

We'll call supermarket_find_in_city with city="Los Angeles", state maybe "California". And openNow default True; they want all supermarkets so probably include those closed too? But instruction says "all supermarkets" not just open now. So set openNow=false or omit? The function signature has optional openNow default true. To get all supermarkets regardless of opening status, pass false.

Second call: sightseeing_popular_in_city with city="Miami", state="Florida".

Return results from both calls as JSON array.

Let's do it.
